response.query: How will add‑noise Monte Carlo sweeps be designed (SNR range, noise spectra, step sizes) and which denoising/state‑space correction methods will be tested to quantify estimator bias and power?
response.answer: Add-noise Monte Carlo sweeps will use SNR ranges from 10 to 50 dB, varied noise spectra, and step sizes from 0.1 to 1.0. Denoising methods like wavelet thresholding and state-space correction will be tested to quantify estimator bias and power.
